events.name: Global Governance Initiative Cyberspace Cooperation Forum chair statement
events.verified_fact: The published chair statement discusses governance of model development and applications as well as inclusive open AI cooperation and public model-related services.
events.interpretation: Both governance and openness appear in current official communication; this statement alone is not proof of a categorical prohibition on open weights.
events.limits: A forum statement is not identified here as an enforceable prohibition or a model-specific takedown notice. This does not establish absence of other legal restrictions.
